title: AstraZit Asset Reference Schema
description: Defines canonical references, storage URIs, format specifications, and checksums for audio, project, artwork, and derivative assets.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier for the asset reference.

uri.description: Absolute storage-provider-independent URI (https:, gs:, s3:, file:, etc.). No embedded data URI or ambiguous relative path.

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the asset binary.

width_px.description: Image or video width in pixels.

height_px.description: Image or video height in pixels.

notes.description: Operational commentary regarding mastering, render settings, or lineage.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this asset was generated or cataloged.

version.description: Asset reference revision; a different binary must retain a distinct asset identity or revision.

derived_from_asset_id.description: Parent asset identity for derivative lineage; referential integrity is checked by future catalog services.
